title: RF23BB8/29 digital — Test Mode entry
description: Fridge + FlexZone 6 s → FlexZone enters Test Mode (FF → Fd sequence).

steps.title: Enter Test Mode
steps.body: Fridge + FlexZone ≥6 s → press FlexZone. Cycle keys: FF → FF r → FF F → FF A → Fd defrost.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Fridge + FlexZone ≥6 s → press FlexZone. Cycle keys: FF → FF r → FF F → FF A → Fd defrost.
